methodology: One capture of each shared official agreement supplies distinct exact-program receiving claims; no course-title or cross-program award inference is used.
The independently reviewed current program ledger supplies receiving codes, names and CU quantities. Original provider semester quantities remain separately reviewed identity facts.
Only exact independently reviewed provider identities are reused in executable options. Other published source-code matches are retained as research leads and excluded from executable choices.
Existing Business Management and Human Resource Management maps use additive verified-identity expansion only. All original option IDs and receiving awards are preserved.
